category_title: High school student with AD/HD exhibiting inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity
minimal_context: Marios is working with his group to complete a worksheet after using the PhET Natural Selection software on the interactive whiteboard.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Marios, now that we've used the PhET Natural Selection software on the interactive whiteboard, please work with your group to complete the worksheet.

STUDENT: It was clear how it changed according to the conditions, how they grew . . . the population was decreasing . . . etc. . . . the class with the use of the interactive whiteboard is more pleasant.

TUTOR: I'm glad you found it pleasant. Now, please write down your observations on the worksheet.

STUDENT: No, nothing in specific impressed me. It was because it was done in a different way . . . it was more interesting. But . . .we will see examples on the interactive whiteboard . . . but we could also follow the traditional way of teaching.

TUTOR: That's an interesting thought. For now, please finish answering the questions on your paper.

STUDENT: I helped the group with the first part, but I'm leaving the rest of these questions unanswered. I don't want to complete the rest of the worksheet.

options.A: Combine the interactive whiteboard activities with 'good teaching' practices during the biology lesson.
options.B: Implement relatively tight timelines for completing the group worksheets during the biology lesson.
options.C: Require the student to use a note-taking app to organize and archive past worksheets.
options.D: Provide a curated list of online biology resources for independent study outside of class.
